stories.title: Genesis — Creation and Eden
stories.description: A calm retelling of creation, the garden, the first man and woman, and the promise that begins the Bible story.

stories.title: Noah — The Ark and the Rain
stories.description: A peaceful retelling of Noah, the ark, the animals, the rain, the dove, the olive leaf, and the bow in the cloud.

stories.title: David and Goliath
stories.description: A peaceful retelling of David's courage in the valley, the sling, the stone, and the God who gave him strength.

stories.title: Jericho — The Quiet March
stories.description: A quiet retelling of the people walking around Jericho, waiting on God's instruction, and seeing the walls fall in His time.

stories.title: Through the Sea by Night
stories.description: A calm retelling of Israel leaving Egypt, the pillar in the night, the sea opening, and the morning song on the far shore.

stories.title: Joseph — The Coat and the Promise
stories.description: A gentle retelling of Joseph's coat, his long road through hardship, and the mercy that brought his family back together.

stories.title: Loaves and Fishes
stories.description: A peaceful retelling of the crowd on the hillside, the five loaves, two fishes, and the baskets gathered at the end.

stories.title: Elijah and the Still Small Voice
stories.description: A calm retelling of Elijah's fire on the mountain, his weary journey, and the still small voice that met him in the quiet.

stories.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
stories.description: A peaceful retelling of Daniel's faithful prayer, the sealed den, the quiet night, and the morning deliverance.

stories.title: The Prodigal Son
stories.description: A warm retelling of the son who went far from home, the road back, and the father who ran to meet him.

stories.title: The Good Samaritan
stories.description: A gentle retelling of the traveller on the road, the wounded man, and the neighbour who stopped with compassion.

stories.title: Jacob’s Ladder
stories.description: A calm retelling of Jacob’s night beneath the stars, the ladder reaching toward heaven, and God’s promise at Bethel.

stories.title: Courage Through the Night
stories.description: A one-hour compilation of David and Goliath, Daniel in the lions’ den, and the walls of Jericho, softly narrated for peaceful evening listening.

stories.title: Psalm 23 — The Shepherd
stories.description: A peaceful reading and reflection on the Shepherd Psalm, the still waters, the valley, and the promise of dwelling with the Lord.

stories.title: Psalm 91 — Under the Shadow
stories.description: A calm reading and reflection on Psalm 91, God’s shelter, His wings, and His faithful protection through the night.

stories.title: Ruth — Where You Go, I Will Go
stories.description: A calm retelling of Ruth’s loyalty, the road to Bethlehem, the fields of Boaz, and the kindness that restored a family.

stories.title: Samuel Hears God
stories.description: A peaceful retelling of young Samuel hearing his name in the night and learning to answer God’s call.

stories.title: Jonah and Mercy
stories.description: A calm retelling of Jonah’s flight, the storm, the great fish, Nineveh, and the mercy of God.

stories.title: Provision, Bread, and Quiet Strength
stories.description: A one-hour collection of Through the Sea by Night, Loaves and Fishes, and Elijah and the Still Small Voice.

stories.title: John the Baptist Prepares the Way
stories.description: A gentle retelling of Zechariah, Elizabeth, the angel’s promise, and the child who would prepare the way.

stories.title: Esther and the Hidden Courage
stories.description: A calm retelling of Esther’s hidden identity, Mordecai’s counsel, and the courage that protected her people.

stories.title: The Beatitudes on the Mountain
stories.description: A peaceful retelling of Jesus teaching on the mountain and the blessings He gave to the humble, merciful, and peacemaking.

stories.title: Mary and Martha
stories.description: A calm retelling of Jesus visiting the home of Mary and Martha and His invitation to choose what matters most.

stories.title: Jesus Calms the Storm
stories.description: A gentle retelling of the storm on Galilee, the frightened disciples, and the voice of Jesus bringing peace to the sea.

stories.title: Gideon and the Fleece
stories.description: A calm retelling of Gideon’s doubts, the fleece, and the patient signs that prepared him to trust God.

stories.title: Providence Hidden in Plain Sight
stories.description: A one-hour collection of Joseph, Ruth, and Esther—three stories of God’s providence hidden in plain sight.

stories.title: The Fiery Furnace
stories.description: A peaceful retelling of three faithful men, the furnace, and the fourth figure seen walking with them in the fire.

stories.title: Rest, Listening, and Peace
stories.description: A one-hour collection of Mary and Martha, Jesus calming the storm, Psalm 23, and Elijah hearing the still small voice.

stories.title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
stories.description: A calm Bible bedtime story of Solomon Asks for Wisdom from 1 Kings 3:3-15, softly narrated for sleep, prayer, rest, and peaceful Christian reflection.

stories.title: Hannah’s Prayer
stories.description: A calm Bible bedtime story of Hannah’s Prayer from 1 Samuel 1:1-28, softly narrated for sleep, prayer, rest, and peaceful Christian reflection.

stories.title: The Good Shepherd
stories.description: A calm Bible bedtime story of The Good Shepherd from John 10:1-18, softly narrated for sleep, prayer, rest, and peaceful Christian reflection.

stories.title: The Transfiguration
stories.description: A calm Bible bedtime story of The Transfiguration from Matthew 17:1-13, softly narrated for sleep, prayer, rest, and peaceful Christian reflection.

stories.title: The Road to Emmaus
stories.description: A calm Bible bedtime story of The Road to Emmaus from Luke 24:13-35, softly narrated for sleep, prayer, rest, and peaceful Christian reflection.

stories.title: The Woman at the Well
stories.description: A calm Bible bedtime story of The Woman at the Well from John 4:1-42, softly narrated for sleep, prayer, rest, and peaceful Christian reflection.
